raw_text: Kaspersky's GReAT team has identified a sophisticated supply chain attack targeting India's Defence Research and Development Organisation. The attackers compromised a third-party IT vendor supplying laboratory management software to DRDO facilities, embedding custom malware within a routine software update. The malware established a covert communication channel with command-and-control infrastructure. Initial analysis attributes the attack to a South Asian APT group with suspected nation-state sponsorship.
clean_text: Kaspersky identifies supply chain attack on DRDO via compromised IT vendor. Custom malware in lab software update with covert C2 channel. Attributed to South Asian nation-state APT.
